args.query: corporate group plan pre-existing disease waiting period

final_answer:
The pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period for a corporate group plan is 12 months of continuous cover. The months are counted from the first policy start date with Saffron Shield, in completed months. 

Sources: 03_Waiting_Periods_Group_Plans.md#how-the-waiting-period-is-checked, 03_Waiting_Periods_Group_Plans.md#pre-existing-disease-waiting-period, 03_Waiting_Periods_Group_Plans.md#initial-waiting-period, 03_Waiting_Periods_Group_Plans.md#overview, 03_Waiting_Periods_Group_Plans.md#moving-to-an-individual-plan
